name: zimvisit
description: ZimVisit - Zimbabwe Tourism Booking & Government Compliance Platform

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run backend" "npm run operator" "npm run government" "npm run ai-service"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/backend/nestjs && npm run build -w apps/operator-dashboard && npm run build -w apps/government-portal
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/operator-dashboard && npm run lint -w apps/government-portal && npm run lint -w apps/backend/nestjs
scripts.setup: npm install && cd apps/backend/ai-service && pip install -r requirements.txt
